title: Exploring the potential and limitations of Model Merging for Multi-Domain Adaptation in ASR
abstract: arXiv:2603.05354v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model merging is a scalable alternative to multi-task training that combines the capabilities of multiple specialised models into a single model. This is particularly attractive for large speech foundation models, which are typically adapted through domain-specific fine-tuning, resulting in multiple customised checkpoints, for which repeating full fine-tuning when new data becomes available is computationally prohibitive. In this work, we study model merging for multi-domain ASR and benchmark 11 merging algorithms for 10 European Portuguese domains, evaluating in-domain accuracy, robustness under distribution shift, as well as English and multilingual performance. We further propose BoostedTSV-M, a new merging algorithm based on TSV-M that mitigates rank collapse via singular-value boosting and improves numerical stability. Overall, our approach outperforms full fine-tuning on European Portuguese while preserving out-of-distribution

translated_title: 探索模型合并在自动语音识别多领域适应中的潜力与局限性
translated_abstract: 模型合并是多任务训练的一种可扩展替代方案，它将多个专门化模型的能力整合到一个单一模型中。这对于大型语音基础模型尤其具有吸引力，因为此类模型通常通过领域特定的微调进行适配，从而产生多个定制化的检查点，而当有新数据出现时重复进行完整微调在计算上是不可承受的。在本工作中，我们研究了面向多领域ASR的模型合并，并针对10个欧洲葡萄牙语领域对11种合并算法进行了基准测试，评估了领域内准确率、分布偏移下的鲁棒性，以及英语和多语言性能。我们进一步提出了BoostedTSV-M，一种基于TSV-M的新合并算法，它通过奇异值提升来缓解秩坍缩问题并改善数值稳定性。总体而言，我们的方法在欧洲葡萄牙语上优于完整微调，同时保持了分布外性能。
tldr: 该研究将模型合并应用于多领域语音识别，提出新算法BoostedTSV-M，在10个欧洲葡萄牙语领域上超越了完整微调，同时保留了分布外性能。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks model merging for multi-domain ASR and proposes BoostedTSV-M, which outperforms full fine-tuning on European Portuguese domains while preserving out-of-distribution performance.
